steps.content: The <color=#fb9259>tunnel</color> seems to have no end. The only lights are the ones at the front of the vehicle. Fortunately, the speed isn't too fast, allowing you to observe your surroundings.
It's a place ravaged by violence and time. It's hard for you to tell if the debris all around you are from wars or natural disasters. Time has corroded everything with rust and buried them in dust.

Nevertheless, the ruins are still impressive. The tracks fork and intertwine with each other along a complex but efficient three-dimensional layout... The entire network is a huge infrastructural masterpiece.

steps.speaker: Black Raven
steps.content: Caw...
That black raven flies over your head, lands on the railcar roof and looks down at you. The door sills under its feet are emblazoned with Rustfire graffiti.
Under the graffiti is an older logo.

The logo depicts the letter "<color=#fb9259>N</color>". In contrast to the messy gangster graffiti, it looks as neat as printed font, and appears in almost every corner of the mine, damaged and corroded.
It looks familiar to you. It feels so out of place in Syndicate, and you feel like you've seen it somewhere in Eastside.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Gosh... What is this place? Have we been whisked away to Eastside?

steps.speaker: Rust
steps.content: You're indeed still in Syndicate.
A Syndican like Hella is even more shocked. Her mouth hasn't closed since she got here.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: I saw a huge <color=#fb9259>robot</color> just now. Even though it's broken now, but that steel claw is still ***ing terrifying.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: If Syndicate really had something like that, the gangs would be nobodies. They'd all kneel and call us "daddy."

steps.speaker: Rust
steps.content: Haha, well, times have changed. The mech you saw was an old model from 28 years ago. That was the golden age of Syndicate.

steps.speaker: Rust
steps.content: The <color=#fb9259>Inner Bay Rail</color> is a special rail track for transporting Hypercubes out of the mines. It's actually a few years older than Keylan Square.

steps.speaker: Rust
steps.content: Too bad it was too close to DisSea. The <color=#fb9259>big explosion</color> destroyed everything.

steps.speaker: Rust
steps.content: Back then, if you stepped above ground, you'd see the industrial center of the world. It was the sole place that produced Hypercubes. Forget about the gangsters—even Eastsiders would call you "daddy."

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: No ***ing way! It was that awesome?

steps.speaker: Rust
steps.content: Yeah. Unlike now, it was an honor to work in West District back then. The best and brightest fought to come to Inner Bay.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Were they really talented?

steps.speaker: Rust
steps.content: Extremely. On average, one of them equals ten Zoyas. You can calculate for yourself how many Hellas that would be.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Ten Zoyas?!! Wow!!! Then that would be...

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: ...Stop messing with me!
A quiet laughter comes from the other end of the phone.

steps.speaker: Rust
steps.content: <size=31>To be honest, I didn't expect them to give you a ride. The conflict between Rustfire and the Executive Committee has worsened, so they desperately need your strength. I thought they'd do everything to convince you to side with the Drifter Camp.</size>

steps.speaker: Rust
steps.content: But it's better this way. Otherwise, you'd be in a very difficult position. The Bureau suits you best.

steps.speaker: Rust
steps.content: Mr. Chief, when you go back after this mission, please get that child to read more. She's from Syndicate, too. She shouldn't be fooled so easily.
steps.female_content: Ms. Chief, when you go back after this mission, please get that child to read more. She's from Syndicate, too. She shouldn't be fooled so easily.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: You little ducker! Come face me if you have the balls! Don't hide behind a phone!

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Quiet. You'll attract the enemy's attention and put us in danger.
This is common banter between the two, but Hecate's tone is exceptionally cold.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Nonsense! You can barely hear me over the screeches of this old railcar. Right, ${PlayerName}?

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Why do you look so grumpy? Hecate, you've been acting really weird lately. Did you pop the wrong pills?
She waves her hand in front of Hecate, who ignores her and goes to keep an eye on the other side.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: ...What's the matter with you... Hey ${PlayerName}, do you know what's going on?
You checked—her physical and mental states are normal, and so are your shackles. But Hecate feels like a different person, and she's even been avoiding your questions lately.
The only reason you can think of is the bloody battle with the Corpseborne. This triggers your pain and guilt—though they're battle-seasoned Sinners, they're still little girls.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Stay alert. There's contamination ahead.
She cuts off your question once again.

steps.speaker: Rust
steps.content: You've entered BR-000's zone of influence. Though BR-000's core body is strictly controlled by the FAC, its radiation is expansive. The Inner Bay area is the most severely affected.

steps.speaker: Rust
steps.content: I think... buzz... buzz buzz... you will soon.... buzz... BR... 2...

steps.speaker: Rust
steps.content: Jammed... buzz...
Hecate stands up and fixes her gaze on the tunnel ahead. At almost the same time, the railcar stops, and several Rustfire members come out.
One of them goes straight to the front of the railcar and replaces the light. The color changes to the faint blue you're familiar with.

steps.speaker: Rustfire Guard
steps.content: We cleaned this just a few days ago. How did dirty things leak into it again?

steps.speaker: Rustfire Guard
steps.content: Be careful, Chief. You can't get hurt.
The others aim their guns at the dark tunnel ahead.
...Something's coming.
